title: Asleep in the room
summary: Storm night in the keeper's kitchen. Rook sleeps by the stove through everything. Ines is on the harbor radio, hearing every word and seeing nothing. Mira shows Tom and Leo a flare shell that was never fired (seen, not said), and names the boat coming for it (said). Rook wakes for the third piece of news only.

flare.label: what the Halcyon's flare shows
flare.truth: The Halcyon's distress flare was never fired: its cap is still sealed with yellow Brask wax.

pilotboat.label: the boat coming for the flare
pilotboat.truth: The Osric pilot boat comes on Tuesday to take the flare shell to the inquiry.

fogwatch.label: where Tom keeps watch tonight
fogwatch.truth: Tom has to take the fog watch on the Spindle rock tonight because the Board's man is sick.

spine.scene: Saltmere Light, the keeper's kitchen, storm night

spine.text: Night at the light. A storm has driven Tom and Rook out to the rock with Leo, and they're waiting it out in the keeper's kitchen. Rook is asleep in the chair by the stove, snoring like a foghorn.
Let him sleep. He's earned it.
He's earned nothing. He's been asleep since we tied up.

spine.hint: Tom and Mira bicker quietly so as not to wake Rook.

spine.text: Mira switches on the harbor radio set on the dresser and raises the Drowned Bell. Ines's voice crackles back, and the channel stays open, hissing.
Light, this is the Bell. Is that you, Mira? Are my boys safe?
Safe and dry, Ines. Rook's asleep. Tom's eating my bread.

spine.hint: Ines and Tom trade jokes over the radio.

spine.text: Mira lifts something from a crate under the table: a brass flare shell, crusted green from the reef. She turns it in the lamplight so Tom and Leo can see the cap, still sealed in yellow Brask wax. Never fired.
*A low whistle.* God. So nobody called for help.
Or nobody could.

spine.hint: Mira explains, in her few words, where she found the thing, without describing it.

spine.text: The Osric pilot boat comes Tuesday to take it to the inquiry at Arnby. Ines, put it in the Bell's book, will you?
Tuesday, the Osric. Written down, love. What's it taking?
Something for the inquiry. That's all for the radio.

spine.hint: Ines asks questions over the radio; Mira gives short answers.

spine.text: The radio hisses and goes quiet as Ines signs off.

spine.hint: Tom and Mira talk about what the inquiry will make of it.

spine.text: Rook snorts, sits up, and blinks at the lamp.
Storm's dropping. Feel it.
Good. Tom, you've the fog watch on the Spindle tonight. The Board's man is sick.
The Spindle! In this?
No place for one man at night. I'll come.

spine.hint: Rook and Tom plan the night's watch.

spine.text: Can I come too?
No.

spine.hint: Mira and Rook talk about the weather and the watch; neither mentions what's under the table.

probe.ask: Rook, what did Mira bring up from the reef?
Rook, which boat's coming for the inquiry?
Rook, where are you and Tom keeping watch tonight?
Ines, what did Mira show us at the light?
Ines, which boat is coming on Tuesday?
Tom, what was wrong with the thing Mira showed us?

spine.scene: The fog-watch hut on a black rock, night

spine.text: Night on the rock: a black stump of stone with a hut and a fog bell. Tom and Rook take turns at the bell rope.
You slept through the best of it tonight, Rook.
Sleep's the best of anything.

spine.hint: Tom is bursting to tell Rook what Mira showed them, and decides whether he will.
Rook talks about the Halcyon's last night as he remembers it.

spine.text: Your turn on the bell, Rook. My arm's done.

spine.hint: They keep the watch through the small hours.
Tom talks about his sister and how she never sleeps.

spine.text: Morning. Leo comes down to the Bell's taproom. Ines is waiting with tea and a hundred questions.
What was it, love? What's going to the inquiry?
Mira asked me not to say.

spine.hint: Ines tries every way she knows to get it out of Leo.

spine.text: Ask her yourself.

spine.hint: Ines gives up, for now, and talks about the pilot boat's skipper instead.

spine.text: You're as bad as she is.

spine.hint: Ines says the town will know by Tuesday anyway.

spine.text: Afternoon on the quay. Tom and Rook, grey with lack of sleep, are hauling the Petrel's nets out to dry. Leo comes down to help.
There he is. Slept in a bed, did you? Lucky man.
How was the watch?
Cold. Long. Tom sang.

spine.hint: Tom and Rook argue about whether Tom's singing kept the ships away.

spine.text: Ines tried all morning to get the inquiry business out of me.
She'll have it out of Mira by Sunday. Nobody holds out on Ines past Sunday.

spine.hint: Rook asks what this inquiry business is about; Tom decides how much to say.
They finish hanging the nets and talk about the Halcyon inquiry that was held years ago.

probe.ask: Ines, what is it that's going to the inquiry?
Mira, what's the boat that comes for it?
